title: עמק האלה — פלוגה על תל עזקה
brief: כחול: פלוגה תופסת את תל עזקה מדרום. אדום: פלוגה מחזיקה בתל. לפני הקרב כל צד מתכנן את משימתו: מטרות רשומות, תצפיות ועמדות חלופיות.

window.place: Tel Azeka over the Elah valley (תל עזקה, עמק האלה): the tel stands at 345 m in the middle of the window, its eastern face falling 110 m to the valley floor, a ridge running south from it and low ground in the east.

about: The Tel Azeka ground at the next echelon up: a BLUE company taking the tel
from the south against a RED company holding it, each commanded at company
level, so each has its company mortars (rules decision 37) as fire missions
(decision 34) — four for the attacker, three for the defender. It is the
battle the planning stage (decision 38) and the call-for-fire control are
played on: both demo platoon battles have no indirect fire at all.
RED holds the tel with two platoons. The first faces south on the shoulder
above the ridge, in positions prepared before the battle; the second holds
the summit, the northern spur and the eastern face. The company command
group is behind the summit. BLUE comes up with three platoons abreast: the
western one on the ridge, in view of the summit all the way; the eastern
one in the lower ground, from which the dead ground of the eastern face can
be reached. Neither side's plan is written here: registered targets,
observation posts and alternate positions are the players' to set before
